description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A rectangular bamboo display top rests on a single woven tapered pedestal. Side: The broad pedestal slopes outward toward a stable lower foot. Rear: The rear reveals the same basket pedestal and a clean bamboo top edge. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
